Tests tree-sitter configuration round-trip

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, TreeSitterConfig, TreeSitterProcessConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/code/hello.py")
    config = ExtractionConfig(tree_sitter=TreeSitterConfig(groups=["web"], languages=["python", "rust"], process=TreeSitterProcessConfig(comments=False, diagnostics=False, docstrings=False, exports=True, imports=True, structure=True, symbols=False)))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
